note: Standing-context byte budgets (spec 2026-08-03, `pnpm context:check`). Every byte musterd injects into a seat's context — tools/list render, primer, hook nudges — measured statically from source-of-truth exports. Raising any budget requires replacing that item's `justification`. bytes are UTF-8 of the model-readable text; estTokens = bytes/4 (the SurfaceRender formula).

toolsListDefaultBytes.justification: 2026-10-15 (20145 B, lane 01M50C7QWJ carried on lane 01M4VKSDJH: `minLength: 1` on team_insight_save's body — the floor refusing empty insight bodies beside ADR 327's cap, +14 B), no headroom added: this buys only the one schema key. Pays rent via the lane's eval — no insight stored with an empty body after 2026-10-15 (docs/wiki/dream-empty-insight-bodies.md, four dated sightings before the floor). Falsifier: an insight saved with body "" is accepted on any later build → the key leaves and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-10-15 (20131 B, lane 01M4VKSDJH, ADR 582 §3: `areas` on lane_open and lane_update, one line each, +285 B), no headroom added: this buys only the declared-area override. Pays rent by letting a seat correct a wrong derivation without writing the database. Falsifier: no lane carries areas_json 30 days after this lands → the two arguments leave and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-10-15 (19846 B, lane 01M4VKS6SF, ADR 582 §4: `q` on lane_board with a one-line description, +62 B), no headroom added: this buys only the argument ADR 582 chose over a `lane_show` tool, which would have cost a whole tool entry. Pays rent by making one lane's brief, history, merge and standing acceptance-ask id one call, where an acceptor read the DB before. Falsifier: no lane_board call carries `q` 30 days after this lands (tool telemetry) → the argument leaves and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-10-13 (19784 B, lane 01M4S53E79: `_meta {"anthropic/alwaysLoad": true}` on the hot tools' tools/list entries, +38 B each, 4 tools, +152 B), no headroom added: this buys only the key. The bytes are wire-only (`_meta` is never shown to the model) but the measure counts the whole entry. Pays rent by removing the ToolSearch turn before a Claude Code session's first musterd call. Falsifier: a Claude Code session on a build with the key still needs ToolSearch before calling team_inbox_check → the key leaves and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-10-12 (19632 B, ADR 561: `source_ref` on lane_open (one-line description) and lane_update (undescribed) — the issue a lane came from, the key `musterd import` re-sync matches on, +194 B), no headroom added: this buys only the one field. Pays rent via the tracker import (spec 2026-10-11): a second import of the same tracker opens no duplicate lane. Falsifier: no lane carries `source_ref` 30 days after `musterd import github` ships → the two arguments leave and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-10-06 (19438 B, ADR 530: a `risk` field on lane_open — the acceptance-risk declaration that was previously unreachable from both lane-open surfaces and so always defaulted to []. One field, no headroom added; pays rent via ADR 530's eval: no human-visible-scope lane opens with risk: [] once this ships, and a human-visible-scope lane opening with risk: [] is the regression falsifier. Previous: 2026-10-05 (19294 B, ADR 526 insight retract/supersede: `supersedes` on team_insight_save, undescribed — the server's refusal teaches the shape (1..8 ids), as ADR 487's fields do; the retract instruction lives in the dreaming skill and CLI help, not the tool text — costing 56 B over the ADR 514 budget), no headroom added: this buys only the one field. Pays rent via ADR 526's eval (nights a fixed finding is still served after its fix lands; baseline the 600-char-clip insights); falsifier: no insight carries `supersedes` within 30 days → the field leaves and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-10-05 (19238 B, ADR 514 inc 3 agent style: `team_style` + `team_style_set` — a human's own dials over four enum fields, descriptions cut to one line each — costing 808 B over the 2026-09-30 budget), no headroom added: this buys only the two tools. Pays rent via ADR 514's eval (inc 6 readout, 30 days after inc 3: humans with a dial set, `length` split on acts to them); falsifier: no human sets a dial by then → the two tools leave and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-09-30 (18428 B, ADR 487 nothing-vanishes: `follows_up` on lane_submit and lane_resolve and `abandon_reason` on lane_update, all three undescribed — the daemon's refusal teaches the shape when a lane declares itself one part of several — costing 88 B over the 2026-09-28 budget) + 2 B, deliberately NOT +5%, as ADR 466's raise: this buys only the three fields. Pays rent via ADR 487 eval (no declared increment, follow-up or to-do left with no lane or disposition, docs/watches/2026-09-30-nothing-vanishes.md). Previous: 2026-09-28 (18331 B, ADR 466 `parked` lane state: +`parked` in every lane-state enum and `park_reason`/`park_until` on lane_update, left undescribed to cost 44 B over the 2026-08-27 budget) + 9 B, deliberately NOT +5%: main had already spent the old headroom, and this raise should buy only the parked state. Pays rent via ADR 466 eval (a shelved lane no longer offered to, or claimable by, agents). Re-baseline with headroom at the next deliberate trim.

The bytes are wire-only (`_meta` is never shown to the model) but the measure counts the whole entry. Pays rent by removing the ToolSearch turn before a Claude Code session's first musterd call. Falsifier: a Claude Code session on a build with the key still needs ToolSearch before calling team_inbox_check → the key leaves and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-10-05 (8154 B, ADR 526: `supersedes` on team_insight_save, which stays on a muted seat, +56 B), no headroom added. Same rent and falsifier as toolsListDefaultBytes. Previous: 2026-10-05 (8098 B, ADR 514 inc 3: `team_style` (read) stays on a muted seat — `team_style_set` is in WRITE_TOOLS and drops — costing 56 B over the 2026-09-03 budget), no headroom added. Same rent and falsifier as toolsListDefaultBytes. Previous: 2026-09-03 re-baseline (7659 B) + 5% headroom. Two things bought this raise, and the second is the reason it is a re-baseline rather than a bump: (1) `team_join {wait}` (ADR 095) costs 91 B and pays rent by removing a measured stall — of 33 claim requests opened from an MCP surface since 2026-07-03, only 5 were decided inside the 120s block the argument makes optional (docs/wiki/claim-approval-latency.md); (2) the prior budget was set 2026-08-27 at 7232 B + 5%, and main had drifted to 7568 B by 2026-09-03 — 336 of its 362 B headroom spent by unattributed growth, so the next byte from any source was going to fail this gate whoever added it. Falsify the rent: if no seat uses `wait: 0` by the next re-baseline, cut the argument and take the bytes back.
